business_problem: KakaoStyle needed a more reliable and governed data foundation because fragmented infrastructure and data quality issues were slowing AI-powered search, recommendations, and commerce operations.
solution_summary: KakaoStyle uses Databricks Data + AI Platform, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, and MLflow to support AI-powered shopping personalization and data operations. KakaoStyle needed a more reliable and governed data foundation because fragmented infrastructure and data quality issues were slowing AI-powered search, recommendations, and commerce operations. In practice, the implementation governs access and lineage with Unity Catalog, coordinates repeatable workflows with Lakeflow, runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks Data + AI Platform, and delivers outputs through Genie. Customer, product, and interaction data are consolidated into a governed cloud data layer; pipeline execution is coordinated with Lakeflow; Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic; results are surfaced through Genie. business_outcome: KakaoStyle reported Transforming personalized shopping by unifying data and AI ~90% reduction, Fewer batch failure alerts for the data engineering team ~2.6x faster, and ~90% reduction, improving AI-powered shopping personalization and data operations with measurable gains in productivity improvement, customer experience, and scalability.
metrics: Transforming personalized shopping by unifying data and AI ~90% reduction

For specific queries, the company achieved execution speeds roughly 2.6x faster than before.
architecture_clues: Uses serverless or elastic compute so capacity can scale up and down with workload demand.
Centralized governance and lineage are enforced through Unity Catalog.
The platform is designed for near-real-time or streaming analysis rather than batch-only reporting.
